record.title: Individual Causal Structure Learning from Population Data
record.reason: Sachs protein-network recovery is an actual biomedical contribution result; selection avoids presenting the generic motivation or stock extension as biomedical evidence.
record.scope_reason: Individual brain/biological causal structure under limited per-individual samples is an explicit central problem, not merely a generic algorithm with a biomedical token benchmark. Real-data evaluation interprets specific fMRI input/brain-region edges and cellular protein perturbation edges, with biological graph accuracy against Sachs reference relations. Stock indices demonstrate an additional domain but do not displace the substantive neuroscience/cellular research direction.
